name: Zap
tagline: Open any project in your code editor in under two seconds, from a Spotlight-style menu-bar palette.
description: Press ⌥ Space, type two or three letters, hit Return: Zap finds the project among the folders you told it to watch and opens it in a new window of your editor. Fuzzy search learns what you open most. 100% local, interface in 20 languages.
